items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Elliot Lawrence was in that band playing tenor sax.

ctx.x: So while you were there that’s when you got this band together, the BandBusters. And how many people?
Yeah, Elliot Lawrence was in that band playing tenor sax. And his dad was the MC and he owned the radio station that we played in every Sunday morning. About fourteen, fifteen guys in the band.
